question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A belief that the Earth is the center of the universe
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Geocentrism .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The belief that the Earth is the center of the universe is referred to as **Geocentrism**.
 
• **Geocentrism** comes from the Greek words "geo" (Earth) and "kentron" (center).
 
• This concept was historically upheld by ancient civilizations and astronomers such as Ptolemy.
 
• It was later replaced by **Heliocentrism**, which states that the Sun is the center of the universe.

Correct term: *The belief that the Earth is the center of the universe is called **Geocentrism**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Heliocentrism:** The belief that the Sun is the center of the universe.
 
• **Anthropocentrism:** The belief that humans are the most important entities in the universe.
 
• **Cosmocentrism:** A worldview that considers the cosmos as a central focus in understanding existence.
